items.quote: Passt Ihnen der Tag nicht, rufen Sie uns spätestens drei Werktage vorher an.
items.computation: Appointment date is Saturday 12.12.2026. 'Werktage' (working days) in common German usage includes Monday–Saturday, excluding Sundays and public holidays. Counting back from the appointment, excluding the appointment day itself: 1st Werktag before = Friday 11.12.2026; 2nd = Thursday 10.12.2026; 3rd = Wednesday 09.12.2026. No public holidays in NRW fall in this window (early December, before Mariä Empfängnis/Christmas). Therefore the call must reach the company at the latest on Wednesday 09.12.2026 for the customer to still be within the 'at least three working days before' requirement.

warnings: The deadline to call and reschedule depends on how 'Werktage' is interpreted (some count only Mon–Fri as working days, which would move the latest call date a few days earlier); verify directly with the company if the Saturday delivery date needs to change.
